messages:
Sam: quick heads-up — PR #8422 landed a change to prefill + KV eviction ordering. ran the microbench (small-batch path) and seeing a p95 regression for small requests (1-4 token outputs). tagging for quick eyes, and requesting a merge hold until we validate. attaching a compact bench summary below. :eyes:

bench-bot: attached bench summary for pr/8422 (small-batch profile)
```
config: small-batch --kernel=q4f16 --kv=true --prefill=adaptive
baseline (main): p50=6ms p95=18ms mem=420MB throughput=1200 qps
pr/8422        : p50=7ms p95=42ms mem=545MB throughput=1180 qps
delta          : p95 +24ms (+133%), mem +125MB (+30%)
notes: regression concentrated on sequences with prefilled KV shards and small token outputs
```

Priya: can you paste the exact bench command + env?

Sam: sure —
`./bench/run --profile=small-batch --model=rwd-base-4k --kernel=q4f16 --kv=true --prefill=adaptive --runs=5000`
ran on dedicated-dev5 (A100s), python 3.11, same docker image tag as canary build.

Marco: whoa p95 18 -> 42 is notable. Is this visible in longseq as well or only small-batch path?

Sam: only small-batch so far. longseq looks unchanged (p95 within noise). suspect the eviction ordering touches the fast-path in prefill that small batches hit.

Elaine: can you share flame graph or perf counters for one of the slow samples? even a stack snippet helps.

Sam: pasted a trimmed perf snippet from one 4-token trace:
```
[slow-sample]
0.000 main_loop
0.001 kv_prefill_check
0.007 kv_evict_try (walk_shards)
0.020 kv_lock_wait
0.030 token_emit
```
looks like a lock wait inside eviction path.

Priya: did this change add any global locks or new sync points? I briefly scanned PR — looks like the eviction collector now does a per-shard compaction inline instead of async.

Sam: yeah that's the change — moved compaction out of background worker to inline to reduce memory churn, but apparently it can contend on small batches.

Marco: my vote: hold merge. we should either revert that inline compaction or gate it behind a config flag with default old behavior for canary.

Elaine: +1 to hold. Suggest: 1) gate behind `KV_PREFILL_COMPACT_INLINE=false` defaulting to false; 2) run a 2hr canary with flag enabled on <test-dedicated> (5% traffic) once we have perf fixes.

Sam: plan accepted. I'll push a quick revert/gate PR in ~15m. For now please don't merge #8422.

Priya: I'll take overnight extended run (12h small-batch sweep) against the gated branch and report stats tomorrow.

Marco: if you need a quick hotfix instead of revert, consider moving the compaction to a try-lock with backoff so it avoids blocking the fast path; that might reduce p95 impact.

Sam: good idea — I'll prototype try-lock backoff and include in the gate PR to compare.

bench-bot: queued extended-run: job id 7821 (12h sweep) — results will be posted to /bench/results/7821 once complete.

deploy-bot: canary hold set: PR #8422 marked "do not merge". Scheduled canary (gated) if/when author requests — will require 2 approvals and a successful 2hr canary run.

Elaine: thanks all. please post the quick perf diff once you have the try-lock prototype — if that looks clean we can consider a short canary after the extended-run completes. :thumbsup:

Sam: will do, thanks everyone.
